eventMetadata.context_description: The 2026 NBA Finals matchup pits the New York Knicks against the San Antonio Spurs, with Game 1 tipping off in San Antonio on June 3. The Spurs enter with the league's best regular-season record at 62-20 and home-court advantage for the first two games, anchored by Victor Wembanyama's interior dominance and the team's strong point differential. The Knicks counter with a 53-29 mark, an 11-game playoff winning streak, and offensive firepower led by Jalen Brunson and Mikal Bridges, having dispatched the Eastern Conference field. Earlier this season, New York defeated San Antonio in the NBA Cup final and snapped an 11-game Spurs winning streak in March. Series resolution hinges on confirmed roster availability, home/road splits, and any late injury designations from official reports.

title: 2026 Seoul Mayoral Election Winner
description:
The 2026 Seoul mayoral election is scheduled to take place on June 3, 2026 to elect the next mayor of Seoul.

This market will resolve according to the listed candidate that wins this election.

If the result of this election isn't known by January 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the South Korean government, specifically the National Election Commission.

eventMetadata.context_description: Incumbent Oh Se-hoon of the People Power Party holds a commanding position in the 2026 Seoul mayoral race following the June 3 local elections, where ongoing vote counts show him maintaining a narrow lead over Democratic Party challenger Chong Won-o amid a razor-thin contest. Exit polls initially projected Chong ahead, but real-time tallies have narrowed the gap to under one percentage point in several reports, with Oh benefiting from his record as four-term mayor and focus on housing redevelopment policies. Ballot shortages in parts of Seoul sparked procedural disputes but have not altered the current trajectory. Other candidates remain marginal factors in the outcome. Late shifts in remaining precincts or official certification could still influence the final result before resolution.

title: US x Iran permanent peace deal by...?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if Iran and the United states agree to a permanent peace deal by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”. 

A permanent peace deal refers to any agreement which explicitly indicates that military hostilities between the United States and Iran have ended or will permanently cease, or uses equivalent language clearly signaling a lasting end to military hostilities between the United States and Iran. Agreements that are explicitly temporary or which do not include a definitive agreement to end military hostilities between the US and Iran on a lasting basis (e.g. a temporary extension of the two-week ceasefire agreement announced on April 7, 2026), will not qualify.

A qualifying agreement will be considered to have been established if either of the following conditions are met:

- The United States and Iran each sign or formally adopt a written agreement (e.g. a treaty or multi-point agreement) which meets the above criteria.

- Both the governments of the United States and Iran provide clear public confirmation that a qualifying agreement has been definitively established. Negotiations, statements of progress, or other statements which do not constitute a definitive announcement that a qualifying agreement has been reached will not count.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: Ongoing U.S.-Iran negotiations center on extending the April 2026 ceasefire, reopening the Strait of Hormuz, and addressing Iran's nuclear program through limits on uranium enrichment and sanctions relief. Recent developments include a late-May tentative 60-day framework agreement reached by negotiators, which President Trump returned with tougher terms, followed by intermittent U.S. self-defense strikes and Iranian missile responses into early June. Direct and mediated talks via Oman and Pakistan continue daily, though Iran has reviewed proposals without full confirmation and sporadic clashes persist. A permanent deal requires explicit, lasting commitments to end hostilities rather than temporary truces, with key sticking points including enrichment capabilities, security guarantees, and broader regional issues. Scheduled diplomatic exchanges and any new military or economic signals in the coming weeks could influence prospects for resolution.

title: Next French Presidential Election
description:
The next French presidential election is currently expected to be held around April 2027.  This market pertains to the outcome of the next French presidential election, regardless of whether it follows the scheduled end of the current term or is held earlier. 

The President of France is elected via a two-round system; a candidate must secure over 50% of the vote to win outright in the first round. If no candidate achieves this, the top two contenders advance to a runoff.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

This market includes any potential second round. If, for any reason, the results of the election are not known by December 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the French Government, specifically the Ministry of the Interior (https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/).

The President of France is elected via a two-round system; a candidate must secure over 50% of the vote to win outright in the first round. If no candidate achieves this, the top two contenders advance to a runoff.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

This market includes any potential second round. If, for any reason, the results of the election are not known by December 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the French Government, specifically the Ministry of the Interior (https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/).

The next French presidential election is currently expected to be held around April 2027.  This market pertains to the outcome of the next French presidential election, regardless of whether it follows the scheduled end of the current term or is held earlier.

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. eventMetadata.context_description: Jordan Bardella leads trader consensus for the 2027 French presidential election at 26.5 percent, reflecting sustained National Rally momentum from municipal election gains and consistent first-round polling near 32 percent amid anti-establishment sentiment. Édouard Philippe follows at 16.5 percent, buoyed by his former prime minister record and cross-aisle appeal, while Jean-Luc Mélenchon at 12.5 percent benefits from left-wing consolidation efforts despite party divisions. The fragmented field, with over 30 declared or potential contenders including Gabriel Attal and Marine Le Pen, limits any single alternative from unifying moderate voters. A scheduled left primary in October 2026 and Le Pen’s ongoing legal appeal could still shift positioning before the April vote.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xavier Becerra holds a commanding lead in trader consensus for the 2026 California governorship due to his strong positioning in the June 2 nonpartisan primary, where early vote counts place him among the top two finishers alongside Republican Steve Hilton. California's top-two system advances the highest vote-getters regardless of party to the November general election, and the state's longstanding Democratic voter registration advantage and historical general election results favor the Democratic nominee in the fall contest. Recent polling ahead of the primary consistently showed Becerra, Hilton, and Tom Steyer separating from the crowded field, with Becerra maintaining an edge among Democrats. Steyer's lower share reflects his third-place standing in ongoing counts, while other listed candidates trail significantly and face structural barriers to advancing or mounting a competitive general election bid.

eventMetadata.context_description: The San Antonio Spurs enter the 2026 NBA Finals as clear favorites in trader consensus, reflecting their 62-20 regular-season mark, second-youngest roster in league history, and Victor Wembanyama’s dominant two-way impact that anchored a deep playoff run capped by a seven-game Western Conference Finals victory over the Oklahoma City Thunder. The New York Knicks, at 53-29 and fresh off a sweep of the Cleveland Cavaliers, offer a competitive counter with veteran leadership and strong defensive metrics but trail in implied probability due to the Spurs’ superior net rating, home-court edge in the series opener, and historical patterns favoring young cores in title pursuits. Recent momentum shifts have modestly narrowed the gap, underscoring the unpredictable nature of Finals outcomes.

eventMetadata.context_description: With no established frontrunner yet for the 2028 Democratic presidential nomination, current market pricing reflects a wide-open field in which Gavin Newsom leads due to his executive experience as governor and sustained national visibility. Contenders such as Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, Kamala Harris, Jon Ossoff, and Josh Shapiro trail, differentiated by legislative records, prior national campaigns, fundraising capacity, and appeal to distinct party factions or regions. Factors that could consolidate support include primary performance trends, endorsement patterns from party leaders, polling shifts among key voter blocs, and positioning ahead of the convention, consistent with historical patterns where early leaders often face challenges from later entrants.

title: Daegu Mayoral Election Winner
description:
The Daegu mayoral election is scheduled to take place on June 3, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

Interim, temporary, or caretaker mayors will not count.

If the result of this election isn't known by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the South Korean government, specifically the National Election Commission (https://www.nec.go.kr/).

eventMetadata.context_description: Choo Kyung-ho of the People Power Party secured a decisive victory in the June 3 local election for Daegu mayor, capturing roughly 53.9 percent of the vote compared to Democratic Party candidate Kim Boo-kyum’s 45.1 percent once nearly all ballots were tallied. Daegu’s longstanding role as a conservative stronghold, combined with Choo’s profile as a senior party figure and former deputy prime minister, drove strong voter support and limited the challenger’s path despite national attention on the race. Official results from the National Election Commission have confirmed the outcome, leaving minimal uncertainty for final certification and market resolution. Late shifts in turnout or legal challenges remain the only narrow avenues that could theoretically alter the result, though none have materialized.
